searchText: Is there any reason why we still have `ttfb_timeout` field on the spec config after depracating it? cc <@592004585506340885> Hmm I didn't know that field was deprecated. We can remove it. Do any clients _need_ it to still exist? we removed it here https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3767 Ah yeah that's right. Yeah now's a decent time to remove it from the config. I will make a PR to remove `TTFB_TIMEOUT` and `RESP_TIMEOUT` from the config. ohh i didn't realise `RESP_TIMEOUT` was also removed. We are still using 10. Do other clients use custom values? Do you use the value from the config? What will happen if it's not there? we just default to the spec values if not provided in the config Made this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4532
